introduction:

vocabulary.definition: reproduction from an ovum without fertilization, especially as a normal process in some invertebrates and lower plants.
vocabulary.example: The female aphids reproduce through parthenogenesis, leading to an all-female generation.

vocabulary.definition: abstaining from marriage and sexual relations.
vocabulary.example: Despite the benefits, very few animal species are completely celibate.

vocabulary.definition: a seemingly absurd or self-contradictory statement or proposition that when investigated or explained may prove to be well founded or true.
vocabulary.example: The paradox of sex in animal species raises questions about the necessity of males.

vocabulary.definition: avoid making a definitive commitment or statement.
vocabulary.example: Aphids hedge their bets by reproducing both sexually and parthenogenetically for survival.

vocabulary.definition: send a group of settlers to establish political control over an area.
vocabulary.example: Female animals that reproduce without males can quickly colonize and control large territories.

vocabulary.definition: not achieving maximum productivity; wasting or failing to make the best use of time or resources.
vocabulary.example: Despite being perceived as inefficient, sexual reproduction has persisted in animal species.
